description.narrative: Lesotho - HEALTH SECTOR PROJECT: This project is designed to mitigate the negative economic impacts of poor maternal health, HIV/AIDS, tuberculosis (TB), and other diseases by substantially strengthening Lesotho's health care infrastructure and health system: capacity of health care workers, national health informatics system, decentralization, research management, and medical waste management.

condition.narrative: Further details on conditions precedent affecting this activity can be found in the top-level parent activities.
